financial_account_uid.description: UID of the Origin Financial Account

payment_account_uid.description: Payment account applied to the entire batch (optional). If omitted, the oldest from the financial account is used. If provided, must belong to the batch's financial account.

payments.description: List of New or Existing Boleto Payments.

payment_account_uid.description: Payment account of origin (optional). If omitted, the oldest from the financial account is used. If provided, must belong to `financial_account_uid`.

external_id.description: ID in your system. Optional for internal control.

custom_data.description: Hash with key and value in JSON format.

beneficiary.description: Beneficiary Data. Required when the financial account is BB; otherwise, optional — when provided, replaces the data extracted from the barcode.

document_number.description: Document Number (CPF or CNPJ). Required when the financial account is BB.
